units.source_text: 这女人与我的幻影没有任何联系。

en.t: This woman had no connection whatsoever with my phantom image.

units.source_text: 她给我的印象完全是停留在第一次见面的另一个体上。

en.t: The impression she gave me remained entirely fixed on another self, the one I had met for the first time.

units.source_text: 女人彬彬有礼的言谈渐渐变得杂乱无章，连看也不看我一眼了。

en.t: The woman's courteous way of speaking gradually became disordered, and she no longer even glanced at me.
